description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of test cases for verifying the behavior of 'git p4' commands related to excluding specific paths during clone and sync operations with Perforce depot. It checks functionalities such as repository creation, cloning with exclusions, and synchronizing updates while excluding certain directories or files.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server needed for testing.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the Git repository after tests.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a specific path exists as a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specific path is missing.
